name: AirVibe LoRaWAN vibration and temperature sensor
short_description: AirVibe is a LoRaWAN condition monitoring sensor that transmits three-axis RMS acceleration, RMS velocity and temperature data, with configurable time waveform transfer.

features.text: Vibration Sensor Module (VSM) and Transmitter and Power Module (TPM) architecture.
LoRaWAN Class A operation, with Class C used during firmware upgrades.
Configurable overall, waveform, or combined reporting modes.
Temperature, acceleration and velocity alarm configuration through downlinks.
Segmented waveform transfers require application-side assembly, acknowledgments and recovery of missing segments.

commercial_fields: Managed separately after owner validation; this package contains no price, inventory, tax, shipping or ordering-code assertions.
